LanguageData.LP_BD_ViciousMockery.label: vicious mockery
LanguageData.LP_BD_ViciousMockery.description: Cantrip, no cadence: say a grating word to one enemy within 24 cells, dealing 6 × inspiration power psychic damage (ignores armor) and shaking it for 6 seconds (melee hit -20%, lower shooting accuracy; mechanoids are not shaken). Cooldown 4 seconds. Bard level 1.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Inspiration.label: bardic inspiration
LanguageData.LP_BD_Inspiration.description: Give Bardic Inspiration to one friendly humanlike within 20 cells (not yourself) for 12 hours: melee hit +10% × inspiration power, better shooting accuracy, work speed +10% × inspiration power, mental break threshold -5%. From bard level 5, there is also a (bard level × 2)% chance to directly grant a vanilla inspiration. Costs 1 cadence, cooldown 30 seconds. Bard level 1.
LanguageData.LP_BD_HealingWord.label: healing word
LanguageData.LP_BD_HealingWord.description: Call out a healing word from afar: instantly heal one target within 30 cells (can be yourself) for a total of 10 × inspiration power injury, worst bleeding wounds first. Costs 1 cadence, cooldown 20 seconds. Bard level 1.
LanguageData.LP_BD_HideousLaughter.label: hideous laughter
LanguageData.LP_BD_HideousLaughter.description: Make one enemy within 20 cells collapse laughing for 8 seconds × inspiration power (unable to move, snaps out at once when damaged). Success = 55% + (inspiration power - 1) × 40%, -5% per point of the target's Wisdom modifier, also offset by mind resistance, range 5%-95%; even on failure they are shaken for 6 seconds. No effect on mechanoids, insectoids and mindless targets. Costs 1 cadence, cooldown 1 minute. Bard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BD_SongOfRest.label: song of rest
LanguageData.LP_BD_SongOfRest.description: Sing lullabies all night for allies within 12 cells: for 12 hours sleep recovery ×1.3, wound healing ×(1 + 0.5 × inspiration power), and everyone gets mood "song of rest" +4 (1 day). Costs 2 cadence, cooldown 1 day. Bard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BD_JackOfAllTrades.label: jack of all trades
LanguageData.LP_BD_JackOfAllTrades.description: Passive: all skills +2 levels, learning speed +15%. Bard level 5.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Countercharm.label: countercharm
LanguageData.LP_BD_Countercharm.description: Sing a melody that steadies the mind: allies within 15 cells are instantly freed from fear, charm and domination; those having a (non-extreme) mental break recover on the spot with 55% + (inspiration power - 1) × 40% chance; then for 1 day mind resistance +30% and psychic sensitivity -30% (bad moods from psychic shocks are lessened accordingly). Costs 2 cadence, cooldown 6 hours. Bard level 5.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Confusion.label: confusion
LanguageData.LP_BD_Confusion.description: Enemies in radius 3 at a point within 20 cells each, by success chance (55% + (inspiration power - 1) × 40%, offset by Wisdom modifier and mind resistance), become confused for 10 seconds × inspiration power: every 2 seconds they randomly zone out, wander, or attack anyone nearby. No effect on mechanoids and insectoids. Costs 2 cadence, cooldown 2 minutes. Bard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Ballad.label: song of renown
LanguageData.LP_BD_Ballad.description: Turn the colony's deeds into a ballad and spread it: pick a faction, goodwill +(5 + 5 × inspiration power) (up to +20), and the whole colony gets mood "our legend" +5 (3 days). If the colony has a bad reputation (has a lich, keeps slaves), it can only be sung as a song of dread, and only hostile factions can be chosen: goodwill still gains half, and that faction's next raid is 10% smaller. Costs 3 cadence, cooldown 7 days (refunded if the window is closed without choosing a faction). Bard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BD_MagicalSecrets.label: magical secrets
LanguageData.LP_BD_MagicalSecrets.description: Passive: at bard level 10, choose one spell from the wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer or warlock lists (class level 7 or lower) to learn permanently; at 13 choose another (class level 10 or lower). Chosen under "choose branch" (the college's branch). Learned spells use inspiration power and cost cadence (the original mana / divinity / pact mana converts 1:1 to cadence). Bard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_BD_MagicalSecrets2.label: magical secrets II
LanguageData.LP_BD_MagicalSecrets2.description: Passive: a second Magical Secret, widened to spells of class level 10 or lower (mass heal, wall of stone, beast lord's call and mass suggestion are also available), not a duplicate of the first. Bard level 13.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Mislead.label: mislead
LanguageData.LP_BD_Mislead.description: Turn invisible for 10 seconds, leaving a taunting illusory double in place: enemies within 15 cells attack the double instead (it vanishes after 10 seconds or a few hits). Used to escape. Costs 3 cadence, cooldown 4 hours. Bard level 13.
LanguageData.LP_BD_WordsOfCreation.label: words of creation
LanguageData.LP_BD_WordsOfCreation.description:
Speak the true words of creation at one target within 20 cells:
Ally: Power Word Heal: heals all wounds (except missing parts), clears pain shock, stuns, fear and confusion, and downed people stand up.
Enemy: Power Word Kill: if the target's overall health is below 35% × inspiration power (up to 70%) it dies outright; otherwise it takes 40 × inspiration power psychic damage and is stunned for 6 seconds. Story bosses and legendary units only take the damage and stun.
Costs 5 cadence, cooldown 1 day. Bard level 15, also requires Social 15.
LanguageData.LP_LegUndyingLegend.label: undying legend
LanguageData.LP_LegUndyingLegend.description: Legendary passive: Bardic Inspiration goes to all friendly humanlikes within 12 cells at once (same cost; the chosen one still has to be within 20 cells); max cadence +3 more (the legendary ability itself +2, +5 in total); inspiration power +20%. Legendary bard.
LanguageData.LP_LegFinalSong.label: song of the finale
LanguageData.LP_LegFinalSong.description: Legendary: sing a 30-second epic. Allies on the whole map don't have mental breaks, gain higher hit chance and pain ×0.5; those downed within the 30 seconds heal half their injuries at once and try to stand up once; enemies within 30 cells have a 25% chance every 5 seconds to flee in fear (mechanoids unaffected). Costs 3 cadence, cooldown 1 day. Legendary bard.
LanguageData.LP_BD_CuttingWords.label: cutting words
LanguageData.LP_BD_CuttingWords.description: Mock one enemy within 20 cells for 20 seconds: melee hit -25%, lower shooting accuracy, damage dealt ×0.75. Works on mechanoids too (ridiculing their design flaws). Costs 1 cadence, cooldown 20 seconds. College of Lore, bard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BD_LoreMastery.label: erudition
LanguageData.LP_BD_LoreMastery.description: Passive: research speed +10% × inspiration power; when learned, the 3 lowest-passion skills (that can be used) each rise one passion step (none → minor → major) and gain +2 levels (once only). College of Lore, bard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraSecrets.label: additional magical secrets
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraSecrets.description: Passive: one more Magical Secret (a spell of class level 7 or lower, not a duplicate of one already learned), chosen under "choose branch". College of Lore, bard level 11.
LanguageData.LP_BD_PeerlessSkill.label: peerless skill
LanguageData.LP_BD_PeerlessSkill.description: Passive: crafted items (art, crafting) have a 30% chance of +1 quality tier (up to legendary); social impact and negotiation ability +15%, surgery success +10%. College of Lore, bard level 15.
LanguageData.LP_BD_CombatInspiration.label: combat inspiration
LanguageData.LP_BD_CombatInspiration.description: Passive: your Bardic Inspiration also grants "Combat inspiration" (damage taken ×0.9, melee damage ×1.15, same duration); your own Shooting and Melee +3 levels. College of Valor, bard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraAttack.label: extra attack
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraAttack.description: Passive: melee attack cooldown ×0.8, aiming time ×0.8. College of Valor, bard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BD_BattleMagic.label: battle magic
LanguageData.LP_BD_BattleMagic.description: Passive: for 5 seconds after each bard ability you cast, the next attack needs almost no aiming, comes out faster and deals ×1.25 damage. College of Valor, bard level 11.
LanguageData.LP_BD_ValorAnthem.label: rallying war cry
LanguageData.LP_BD_ValorAnthem.description: Sing a war song: allies within 15 cells get pain ×0.5, movement ×1.2 and mind resistance +50% for 30 seconds, and those fleeing in fear snap out of it at once; you gain a shield absorbing 20 × inspiration power damage (takes the higher of this and the Inspiring Leader shield, does not stack). Costs 3 cadence, cooldown 4 hours. College of Valor, bard level 15.
LanguageData.LP_BD_BladeFlourish.label: blade flourish
LanguageData.LP_BD_BladeFlourish.description: Passive + button: movement ×1.15; melee hits have a 30% chance to perform a flourish of the current style (Defensive: gain an absorb shield of 10 × inspiration power for 5 seconds; Slashing: deal the same damage to another adjacent enemy; Mobile: knock the target back 2 cells). The button cycles Defensive / Slashing / Mobile, and toggles "spend cadence" (each flourish costs 1 cadence and always triggers). College of Swords, bard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraAttackBlade.label: extra attack
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraAttackBlade.description: Passive: melee attack cooldown ×0.8, aiming time ×0.8 (same as the College of Valor ability of the same name). College of Swords, bard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BD_BladeWhirl.label: whirling blade dance
LanguageData.LP_BD_BladeWhirl.description: Pick an enemy within 8 cells and dance through it and enemies around it (up to 5), each taking one hit from your current melee weapon at × inspiration power damage, ending next to the last enemy. Costs 2 cadence, cooldown 1 minute. College of Swords, bard level 11.
LanguageData.LP_BD_MasterFlourish.label: master's flourish
LanguageData.LP_BD_MasterFlourish.description: Passive: in combat, regain 1 cadence every 10 seconds while below 2; Blade Flourish trigger chance 30% → 60%. College of Swords, bard level 15.
LanguageData.LP_BD_SilverTongue.label: silver tongue
LanguageData.LP_BD_SilverTongue.description: Passive: negotiation ability ×1.5 (easier recruiting and persuasion), trade prices +10%, social impact +20%. College of Eloquence, bard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BD_InfectiousInspiration.label: infectious inspiration
LanguageData.LP_BD_InfectiousInspiration.description: Passive: when your Bardic Inspiration expires or its holder is downed, it passes to another uninspired friendly humanlike within 10 cells (each inspiration passes at most once, duration restarts). College of Eloquence, bard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BD_UniversalSpeech.label: universal speech
LanguageData.LP_BD_UniversalSpeech.description: Passive: chatting with people of non-hostile factions such as visitors and caravans gives +1 goodwill with their faction (up to +5 per day); your Bardic Inspiration lasts 3 days. College of Eloquence, bard level 11.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Truce.label: words of truce
LanguageData.LP_BD_Truce.description: Call out to anyone in a raiding humanlike group (within 30 cells). Success = 30% + (inspiration power - 1) × 40%, +5% for each member of their group who is downed or dead (up to 90%). Success: the whole group gives up the raid and leaves the map, and that faction's goodwill +10. Failure: that person is shaken for 30 seconds. No effect on mechanoids, insectoids, undead, outsiders and raids led by story bosses. Costs 5 cadence, cooldown 15 days. College of Eloquence, bard level 15.
